title: Uses Audit -- interface->impl moves + unused (this unit)
summary: For one unit, reports which uses entries could move from the interface section to implementation, and which are unused entirely
intro: Read this when tidying the uses clauses of one unit: it reports which entries could move from the interface section to implementation and which are not used at all.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Uses & Dependencies > Uses Audit -- interface->impl moves + unused (this unit)...

surfaces.usage: drag-lint uses-audit <unit.pas> --db <file.sqlite> [--format json|text] (interface->impl moves + unused units)
help: drag-lint uses-audit <unit.pas> --db <file.sqlite> [--format json|text]   (interface->impl moves + unused units)
